senses.gloss: Someone who makes; a person or thing that makes or produces something.
A person who carries out some task.
Someone who does, performs, or executes; an active person, an agent.
A masculine pronoun; he as a grammatical object.
Of or relating to society.
(intransitive) To interact with others, especially personally, informally and off the clock rather than formally and officially.
Who enjoys being in crowds and socializing.
Informal, affable and familiar.
Naturally and genuinely easy to get along with.
Having the characteristics of a worthy companion; friendly and sociable.
The total for a part of a list of numbers being summed.
To increase in wealth or success; to prosper, be profitable.
The chief administrator of a school.
Inclination towards something.
An adverse judgment or opinion formed beforehand or without knowledge of the facts.
An opinion formed before obtaining adequate evidence, especially as the result of bias or prejudice.
(politics) Someone who has strong influence over the choice of a leader.
One who manipulates or controls another as by some mesmeric or sinister influence; especially a coach, mentor or industry mogul.
A small cigar consisting of tobacco or another substance, wrapped up in a thin roll with paper, intended for smoking.
A cylinder of tobacco rolled and wrapped with an outer covering of tobacco leaves, intended to be smoked.
A thin cigar, differing from a cigarette in being wrapped with tobacco leaves rather than paper.
An expression of remorse or regret for having said or done something that harmed another: an instance of apologizing (saying that one is sorry).
An individual's physical or mental disadvantage or disability.
Never before seen, done, or experienced; without precedent.
A cage to keep pet or zoological specimen birds in.
A person or persons with whom one is acquainted.
The visible part of the ear in most therians that resides outside of the head, the auricle; outer ear excluding the ear canal.
At a later or succeeding time; after that;
The starting point of a logical deduction or thought; basis.
emphasise a noun
Related to a foundation, base, or basis; serving as a foundation.
Something considered as a reason or ground for a (possible) decision.
A basic or essential supply.

A military action consisting of a large armed force of one geopolitical entity entering territory controlled by another such entity, generally with the objective of conquering territory or altering the established government.
The control of a nation or region by a hostile military or paramilitary force.
The cardinal number 20, occurring after nineteen and before twenty-one.
A machine that generates froth
The chief devil; Satan.
An evil supernatural being.
(religion) The supreme evil spirit in the Abrahamic religions, who tempts humanity into sin; the Devil; (Theistic Satanism) the same figure, regarded as a deity to be revered and worshipped.
A demon said to feed on corpses.

(mythology, literature) Any of numerous figures featuring in various mythologies and folk traditions, who use guile and secret knowledge to challenge authority and play tricks and pranks on others with their acts of trickery; any similar figure in literature.
(Islam) Iblis, Satan.
The point where two converging lines meet; an angle, either external or internal.
The compass point halfway between east and southeast; specifically at a bearing of 112.5°.
To trust to the care of.
To entrust to the care of another.
The net-like construct of a spider containing sticky strands to catch prey.
To alter something from its true state, as to hide a flaw or uncertainty, deliberately but not necessarily dishonestly or immorally.
One who loves and cares for another person in a romantic way; a sweetheart, love, soulmate, boyfriend, girlfriend, or spouse.
In love.
A document granting permission to pass or to go and come; a passport; a ticket permitting free transit or admission
An official document normally used for international journeys, which proves the identity and nationality of the person for whom it was issued.
Of a color between black and white, having neutral hue and intermediate brightness.
Uncultivated and unsettled land in its natural state inhabited by wild animals and with vegetation growing wild; (countable) a tract of such land; a waste or wild.
An area located outside of towns and cities; an area that is not urban or suburban; a rural area.
An extensive waste covered with patches of heath, and having a poor, light (and usually acidic) soil, but sometimes marshy, and abounding in peat; a heath. (Compare bog, peatland, marsh, swamp, fen.)
An area dominated by grass or grasslike vegetation.
The grasslands of Eastern Europe and Asia.
Of a period of time: having just gone by; previous.
An irregular line left from smearing or motion.
A European willow, Salix caprea, that has broad leaves, large catkins and tough wood.
The name of the Latin script letter R/r.
A cunning person.
A bay horse
Pertaining to a fox.
The act of legislating; preparation and enactment of laws.
Having attained a level of higher education, such as a college degree.
Moisture; humidity; dampness.
Infrequently, rarely.
The act of resisting, or the capacity to resist.
The tendency to recover from perturbations.
Something that is not convenient, something that bothers.
(electronics) An electric component that transmits current in direct proportion to the voltage across it.
A sketch or account of anything in words; a portraiture or representation in language; an enumeration of the essential qualities of a thing or species.
A statement of the meaning of a word, word group, sign, or symbol; especially, a dictionary definition.
To bring in a harvest; reap; glean.
(figuratively) Anything that covers or conceals something else; a cloak. [from 9th c.]
organ that synthesizes and secretes substance
(anatomy) A clear division of an organ that can be determined at the gross anatomy level, especially one of the parts of the brain, liver or lung. [from Template:SAFESUBST: c.]
(malacology) The mantle of a mollusc. [from 19th c.]
A person employed to inspect something.
A portion of land or territory as defined by its landform, its geographical (and architectural) features.
lesser in importance
Next in order to the first or primary; of second place in origin, rank, etc.
Secondary or subordinate.
A precious stone, usually of substantial monetary value or prized for its beauty or shine.
A precious or semi-precious stone; gem, gemstone.
A legume plant (Glycine max), commonly cultivated for human and animal consumption and as a nitrogen-fixing ground cover.
pertaining to history
Very important; noteworthy: having importance or significance in history.
Of, from, or pertaining to the Kingdom of Hungary, during the days of the Austro-Hungarian Empire, regardless of ethnicity.
Plunder taken from an enemy in time of war, or seized by piracy.
The ability to move; capacity for movement.
place where some sports take place
A closely woven fabric (originally of silk, now also of cotton or man-made fibres) with a thick short pile on one side.
The capital city of Iran, the seat of Tehran County's Central District and the capital of Tehran Province.
Arrangement, disposition, or sequence.
The setting of written material into type.
To play the ball between the legs of (an opponent).
A system consisting of the parts of an engine through which burned gases or steam are discharged; see also exhaust system.
(clocks, mechanics) The linkage in a (watch) that gives impulses to the timekeeping element and periodically releases the gear train to move forward, advancing the clock's hands.
(informal) A contact lens.
A drama or similar work, in which the main character is brought to ruin or otherwise suffers the extreme consequences of some tragic flaw or weakness of character.
Kinship; being related by blood or marriage.
Relation or connection by blood, marriage or adoption.
(US) Relatives, relations.

A long or larger molecule consisting of a chain or network of many repeating units, formed by chemically bonding together many identical or similar small molecules called monomers. A polymer is formed by polymerization, the joining of many monomer molecules.
Obscured by mist or fog; unclear; hazy.
An ox-like mammal native to the Himalayas, Mongolia, Myanmar, and Tibet with dark, long, and silky hair, a horse-like tail, and a full, bushy mane.
The length of such a line; the distance measured perpendicularly from a figure's vertex to the side opposite to the vertex.
Any large piece of timber or iron long in proportion to its thickness, and prepared for use.
A string.
straight line
A tough band of flexible but inelastic fibrous collagen tissue that connects a muscle with its bony attachment and transmits the force which the muscle exerts.
A mechanism powered by a coiled spring and regulated by some form of escapement; the power is transmitted through toothed gearwheels and used to drive a mechanical clock, toy, or other device.
Beam, crossbeam; squared timber; a tie beam of a house, stretching from wall to wall, especially when laid so as to form a loft, "the balks".
A beam of steel, wood, or reinforced concrete, used as a main horizontal support in a building or structure.
The string of an archer's bow.
To overcome, quieten, or bring under control.
To remove the skin and/or fur of an animal or a human.

Pertaining to the regions east of the Mediterranean, beyond the Roman Empire or the early Christian world; of the Near East, the Middle East or the Far East, now especially relating to East Asia. [from 15th c.]
Any of various compounds and substances containing the vinyl radical, especially various tough, flexible, shiny plastics.
A rite; a repeated set of actions, especially in religious contexts.
Of a disease: epidemic over a wide geographical area and affecting a large proportion of the population; also, of or pertaining to a disease of this nature.
To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.
A sleeveless garment or part of a garment, hanging from the neck over the back, arms, and shoulders.
Former name of Khujand: a city in Tajikistan.
A city and associated province of Piedmont, Italy.
A highly flammable, viscous substance, designed to stick to the body while burning, used in warfare as an incendiary especially in wooded areas. [from 1942]
Anything that whirls or spins around, such as a toy top or a merry-go-round.
A piece of paper twisted to be used as a container.
A three-legged stand,mount or organism
Not having, containing, characteristic of, etc.
Any form of an element that has a distinctly different molecular structure to another form of the same element, with different physical properties and often different chemical properties.
The act of standing on one's hands, most often in an inverted way.
Showing composure.
Free from tension or anxiety; at ease; leisurely. [from 18th c.]
Free from emotional or mental disturbance.
Characterized by leisure; taking plenty of time; unhurried.
The quality or state of being still.
(uncountable) The state of being calm; tranquillity; silence.
Not showing, and not affected by, emotion, bias, or prejudice.
White or grey with age.
An Ashkenazi Jew.
A scientist whose speciality is microbiology.
A microbiologist whose speciality is bacteriology.
A semisynthetic narcotic analgesic that is administered in the form of its hydrochloride C₂₉H₄₁NO₄·HCl to control moderate to severe pain and treat opioid dependence.
(Roman god) The Roman goddess of agriculture; equivalent to the Greek goddess Demeter.
Mentally quick and resourceful; skilled at achieving what one wants in a mentally agile and inventive way.
Skillful at deceiving others.
Enmity, ill feeling; (countable) a feeling of animosity or a dispute.
The art of dramatic composition for the stage.
A en given name.
A transition area between two adjacent ecological communities (ecosystems).
A vehicle, often on tracks, used to dig ditches etc.
A point, or value that is a maximum or a minimum.
To saturate, or infuse.
The rise and fall of the voice in speaking.
A weapon which has the (usually spherical) striking part attached to the handle with a flexible joint such as a chain.
(transitive, intransitive) To take for granted; to conclude, with less than absolute supporting data; to believe.
(intransitive) To make an inference based on inconclusive evidence; to surmise or conjecture.
wealthy and industrialized; not third-world.
A mule driver.
The capital city of the province of Quebec, Canada.
(historical) A member of a nomadic Turkic people of central Asia who ruled parts of Eurasia and Eastern Europe in the Middle Ages.
(historical) Any of a group of early-19th-century English textile workers who destroyed machinery because it would harm their livelihood.
The surgical procedure to remove all or part of a breast and sometimes nearby tissues.
The onset of menstruation; a girl's first period.
A specialized structure found inside cells that carries out a specific life process (e.g. ribosomes, vacuoles).
An act of authorizing.

The theory of poetry, or of literature in general.
(historical) A historical region of Southern Africa, the area now occupied by Zimbabwe and Zambia. [used from 1895 to 1964]
To compose or perform poetry or songs.
A member of the Sasanian dynasty.
A chart, list, or record of ancestors, to show breeding, especially distinguished breeding.
(linguistics) A play on words on a phrase in which the initial (usually consonantal) sounds of two or more of the main words are transposed.
(organic compound) A glyceride (especially the triglyceride) of stearic acid
An explanation of the basis or fundamental reasons for something.
Longer hair growth on back of neck of an animal, especially a horse or lion.
The hair of a horse, especially from the mane and tail, used for upholstery.
(transitive) To divide or separate the parts of (especially something flimsy, such as paper or fabric), by cutting or tearing; to tear off or out by violence.
(music) Chiefly in rock and heavy metal: to play (a musical instrument (especially a guitar) or a piece of music) very fast and in a way that requires technical skill.
To tear apart by force; to rend; to split; to cleave.

Rheum, crusty or gummy discharge found in the corner of the eyes after waking, whether real or a figurative objectification of sleep (in the sense of reduced consciousness).

eye discharge — see also sleep
(constellation) A summer constellation of the southern sky, said to resemble a chisel.
To flavour food with spices, herbs or salt.
The separation of the constituent parts (of a spectrum etc).
An association, or a reaction, of a solute with a solvent.

A semiaquatic monotreme from eastern Australia with a bill resembling that of a duck, that has a mole-like body, a tail resembling that of a beaver, a waterproof pelt, and flat webbed feet (Ornithorhynchus anatinus).
